04 / Before you visit

Good to know.

Is my date available?

Only the venue can confirm live availability. Sending an enquiry does not reserve a date.

Are prices or packages listed here?

No. Ask for a current written quotation, inclusions and any applicable taxes or cancellation terms.

Can I arrange a viewing?

Contact the venue first to confirm visiting hours, exact entrance and the right person to meet.
